document_scope: Entire92-page gazette issue; contains Decree320 and other instruments. Do not index all issue text as Decree320.
findings: Article12(2)(a) directs treaty-country investments to the applicable treaty.

Article12(2)(b) addresses non-treaty-country investments: b2 includes tax paid abroad or paid on behalf, and specified exempted/reduced foreign tax; not merely an unconditional direct withholding credit.
b3 requires supplemental filing after later foreign tax payment; b5 specifies recognition period and prohibits offsetting foreign project losses/profits against domestic profits/losses.
Article12(2)(c) contains separate allocated top-up-tax credit provisions with a combined cap.
required_correction: Replace claim that implementing decree is absent and direct-credit-only assumption. Model treaty route, actual payment/timing and applicable relief separately; source admission alone is insufficient.
limitations: Review of selected original provisions, not all later corrigenda/amendments or a completed credit calculator.

document.title: Decree320/2025/ND-CP: original Gazette1737-1738 rendition
document.note: Archived full92-page issue; scoped parser extracts only Decree320 body on pages2-83, excluding following Resolution66.10. Original regulation, not consolidated later amendments/corrigenda. Tax-period application and transition require Article24/25 review; no all-years approval inferred.

engine_review.current_mechanism: Credit is represented by direct and underlying boolean effects; dividend path computes min(home tax, source withholding plus permitted underlying tax).
engine_review.covered_treaty_rules: Ten Vietnam incoming treaty-credit rules exist for the other ten covered jurisdictions; underlying-credit rules exist for Hong Kong and Singapore. They must be reviewed individually, not replaced by the non-treaty paragraph.
unrepresented_requirements: Allocated top-up-tax combined cap and timing
engine_review.decision: Do not flip credit_underlying globally or treat source rebinding as full credit repair. Update treaty and non-treaty eligibility separately and extend calculation inputs where existing booleans cannot represent the law.

corrigendum_review.limits: Other amendments and implementing rules still require review.
